questions.stem: A 2-day-old neonate born to a diabetic mother had a blood glucose of 29mg/dl during a routine follow-up. The neonate is otherwise active and shows no signs or symptoms of hypoglycemia. What is the next management step?

options.label: D
options.text: Oral feeds and recheck sugar after 30 min
